predicates.name: F1 — the declared falsifier: do the fitted conventions AGREE about the verdict?
predicates.statement: the three position-dependent conventions' 90th-percentile verdicts on C-0063's placement: FLAT_BAND NOT flat, EXPONENTIAL NOT flat, LATTICE_RING NOT flat, MEASURED_DEPTH NOT flat

findings: THE MANDATE HALF NEEDS NO PIPELINE AND IT IS THE LARGER EFFECT. C-0017's mandate is an equality on a SUM, so a dropout's cost to it is E[K] = sum k_i p_i: at CH-0084's position-independent 0.84 that is a 16.0 % shortfall, and on the 3 x 15 grid's own stations the fitted position-dependent field makes it 17.5 % (flat band) and 19.9 % (exponential). A trim cannot recover any of it, because the missing paths are not there to trim.

THE MEASURED BOUNDARY LAYER IS WIDER THAN ONE LATTICE CELL, AND THAT IS A CHECK THE MEASUREMENT ITSELF SUPPLIES. The mechanism Strauss names -- staples at the edges and corners missing neighbouring helices and stacking -- read literally at one lattice cell predicts a mean incorporation of 0.9010 on the reference rectangle against the measured 0.8400. Fitting the width instead gives a 4.62 nm band or a 5.00 nm exponential decay, i.e. 1.7 to 1.9 interhelical distances.

A 40 nm TILE IS NOT A ROTHEMUND RECTANGLE AND THE TRANSFER IS PESSIMISTIC. The same fitted boundary layer over the Gen-1 tile's area gives a mean incorporation of 0.7587 (flat band) and 0.7733 (exponential) against the measured 0.8400 -- because a 40 x 40 nm tile has 1.85x the perimeter per unit area of the reference rectangle. CH-0084's 0.84 is therefore the OPTIMISTIC reading of its own measurement on this object.

CH-0084's 48 % IS ONE CORNER OF 168, NOT THE EDGE. Read off the map itself rather than off the abstract, the perimeter MEAN incorporation is 0.775 and the interior mean 0.862, against the single worst cell at 0.479 — which is a CORNER, while the four corners run 0.479, 0.602, 0.699, 0.871 and the best of them is ABOVE the interior mean. Six of the 52 perimeter cells beat the interior mean and the perimeter's standard deviation is 1.81x the interior's. So a field that puts the whole rim at 0.48 is harsher than the measurement, and the MEASURED_DEPTH convention — no fit at all — is the fair reading.

A SINGLE MISSING STAPLE ALREADY LOSES THE VERDICT, AND THAT NEEDS NO MONTE CARLO. Removing exactly ONE of C-0063's 34 paths — 34 solves — takes the optimised placement from 0.0706 to 0.5010 of the stroke at its worst station, and one of C-0058's 45 takes the two-level design from 0.0753 to 0.3060. An exhaustively optimised placement is a delicately tuned cancellation, and the dropout distribution below is a property of THAT before it is a property of the incorporation field.

THE VERDICT. Under the fitted flat-band dropout as built, C-0063's 34 equal springs dish 0.6161 at the median and 0.8074 at the 90th percentile of the stroke against T-5b's 0.10, exceeding it in 100.0 % of realisations (standard error 0.0000); C-0058's two-level rim x 5 dishes 0.5296 and 0.6771, exceeding in 99.9 %. At zero dropout the same two are 0.0706 and 0.0753.

THE SPATIAL STRUCTURE IS WORTH THIS MUCH: at the SAME mean dropout, CH-0084's position-independent field puts C-0063's 90th percentile at 0.5346 and the fitted flat band at 0.8074, a factor of 1.51; on C-0058's two-level design the same pair is 0.3954 and 0.6771, a factor of 1.71. So the challenge's own qualification is quantified, and the direction is ADVERSE — the position dependence makes it worse.

THE DROPOUT REVERSES THE RANKING OF THE TWO FLAT DESIGNS. At zero dropout C-0063's 34 EQUAL springs (0.0706) beat C-0058's two-level 45 (0.0753), which is C-0063's own headline. Under the measured dropout the order inverts: 0.6391 against 0.4893 at the 90th percentile, and 99.8 % against 97.0 % exceedance. Losing ONE path costs the 34-root placement 0.5010 and the 45-path grid 0.3060, so what the dropout rewards is a denser, more regular array — and the equal-spring advantage C-0063 and CH-0080 both read as a property of the placement is, under fabrication, a LIABILITY.

THE MEASURED MAP IS THE MILDEST READING AND IT STILL FAILS, WHICH IS THE STRONG FORM OF THE VERDICT. Transferred by its own measured depth profiles with NO fit, the map gives the Gen-1 tile a station-mean incorporation of 0.8065 on the 3 x 15 grid and 0.7835 on C-0063's 34 roots, against the fitted flat band's 0.6459 — and the flatness verdict is still lost at 97.0 % and 99.8 % of realisations. Over all 20 placement-by-convention cells as built the LOWEST exceedance anywhere is 90.6 %.

HOLDING THE MANDATE IS NOT A REPAIR AND COMPENSATION IS NOT EITHER. On C-0063's placement the same flat-band dropout gives a 90th percentile of 0.8074 as built, 0.9122 with the survivors rescaled to C-0017's total, and 0.8148 with every path pre-stiffened by its own inverse incorporation. The dropout costs the SHAPE of the coupling, not only its level.

THE DECLARED FALSIFIER F1 DID NOT FIRE: the three fitted conventions agree about C-0063's 90th-percentile verdict, and the lattice-ring reading -- the one the measured mean rejects -- is the mildest of the three at 0.7326 against the flat band's 0.8074. The rigorous reachable-dishing floor over all four station sets is 0.0055, so the cheap bound could not have settled it and the Monte Carlo was necessary.
validity: TRL 1-3. Model-consistent and traceable. The INPUT is measured — Strauss et al. (2018), read directly — and nothing derived here is.

Strauss measures STAPLE incorporation on a plain Rothemund rectangle at one folding protocol. A Gen-1 coupling path is a designed element whose own incorporation nobody has measured, and the out-of-plane motif every element stands on is NOT demonstrated (C-0028, C-0029, C-0055).
The MAPPING onto a 40 nm tile is a CONVENTION and is carried as three of them. The reference geometry is DERIVED from the p7249 scaffold, not read, and is bracketed at 22/24/26 helices.
Realisations are INDEPENDENT across stations. Strauss reports no correlation length; a folding-run-to-folding-run common mode would change the distribution's shape and is not modelled.

The dishing pipeline, the lattice, the load and the free-tile stroke are C-0058's, C-0063's and C-0074's unchanged, and inherit their whole validity range — C-0022's unsourced rim charge, C-0001's single foundation secant, one crossover layout per placement.
T-5b's 0.10 is a CONVENTION, not a physical threshold.
The 90th percentile is the reported verdict statistic. It is a choice: nothing upstream says what fraction of built tiles a design is allowed to lose.
openQuestions: Whether a placement exists that is flat under the dropout. This study grades the standing designs; it does not search for a new one.
Whether the coupling element's own incorporation is the staple's. Strauss's number is the right ORDER and the only measured one, not the coupling's own.
Whether the dropout is correlated within a folding run. Independence is a convention here and a measurable quantity in Strauss's own instrument.
What fraction of built tiles a flatness verdict is owed over. The 90th percentile is this claim's choice and no upstream clause fixes it.
Whether over-stiffening the rim paths to compensate is affordable once C-0014's thermal force and the per-path allowable are re-read at the compensated level.
